title: FFmpeg 1.0.0
release_notes:
• Full FFmpeg 8 engine on-device: convert, transcode & compress to exact target sizes
• Cuts: instant keyframe-snapped stream-copy or frame-accurate re-encode, with live thumbnail strip and keyframe markers
• Audio Studio: two-pass LUFS mastering (YouTube/Podcast/Broadcast presets), channel routing, soxr resampling
• Extract audio, frames, palette-optimized GIFs, and SRT/ASS/WebVTT subtitles
• Filter stack: crop, scale, rotate, speed, volume, denoise, sharpen and PNG watermark — gated honestly to what your device's build supports
• Capture: in-app camera photo/video and mic recording straight into the pipeline
• Live streams: record HTTP/HTTPS/HLS/DASH on-device — Stop keeps what you captured
• Join clips with instant lossless merges or crossfade transitions
• Serial job queue with per-job progress, pause/resume, cancel and a persistent banner
• Media dossier: stream & codec inspection with rotation, chapters and dispositions, a shareable report, and lossless remux track-picker copies
• Before/after A/B preview, audio player, and swipe-undo history
